title: Released a Roguelite Card-Based TD on Mobile!
author: Kaahl10
selftext:
I released my first AI-assisted game that I'm proud of, called Arcane Gears.  I'm happy to hear any feedback or suggestions!

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.higategames.hexfront&hl=en\_US](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.higategames.hexfront&hl=en_US)

My goal was to combine Arcane Rush/STS card mechanics and merging with traditional tower defense.

**AI Stack Used:**

\- Claude Opus for spearheading most of the brainstorming and coding and ongoing balance testing

\- ChatGPT for initial images and icons

\- AutoSprite for enemy and summon walking animations (still work in progress)

\- Suno and Elevenlabs for music and some SFX

\- Grok for promotional material
